limits: VM-only two actual USB devices, ordinaryUID1000/caps0 and running authenticated same daemon/bus. No host experimental deployment or hub power action.

Explicit cancel-discovery cancels both Ready registration policies by actual kernel Managed release/revocation/drain/reacquisition. It returns generation confirmation, not a fabricated successful STOP or operation ID. Original raw STOP0b failure remains independent.

First actual scan parameter reply held; original caller returns Cancelled before drain. Actual cancel CLI SIGKILL/reap while kernel Revoking, or second cancel CLI actual Busy failure. Actual same-generation Managed/owned Held after drain, followed by actual scanSTART/STOP proves business authority; target only original1001 plus post-drain1001/START/STOP. Peer On maintained throughout. Original SHA/length and full capture independently corroborated.

This qualifies abandoning the cancel CLI and competing cancellation on the first held scan parameter reply, not cancellation/removal, all RPC/result/event/authority concurrency, physical hotplug or natural nonmanual recovery. Token-redaction and unsupported-fd source tests remain source support only.
Same-image artificial guest IN error and RF20+2 are separately corroborated development support, not autonomous natural fault recovery, physical unplug/replug or PHY capture.

Current image physical hotplug,four-device two-pair RF,natural startup/disappearance RCA and no-manual per-device recovery remain open; all28 original issues and2drafts remain open/unmerged; completeS0-S6 preserved.
